◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
The deer. The cleanest kill. The table goes very still. Behind you, your own people go still too — a different stillness.
"Send your champion." The table goes quiet in eleven dimensions.

◈ TRIAL BY COMBAT — the challenge pauses. This is not a metaphor. The Finale steps forward — the table's champion, the last thing the show ever made. Win, and terror is no longer a meter but a fact. Lose, and the mantle passes mid-table; the village continues weakened. This is the only door with death behind it, and you chose it.

◈ TRIAL LOST — the champion stands over the body. The mantle passes mid-table; a new face sits in the pale light, and the village negotiates weakened. The story does not end — it never does — but the terms just got worse.
You spend it — the shield, not the sword. The small envoy stares. Your people stand a little straighter. Protective terror: the table writes it down and doesn't understand it, which is the point.

The most frightening thing you ever did. The table doesn't know what to do with mercy from a predator. Neither do you, quite. But the audience weeps, and the galaxy learns that the feared one chose gentleness — and that choice echoes longer than any threat. The terror stays, pledged now: a shield over every village, forever.
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.

The ring of pale light. The too-many-angled faces. The trillions of eyes.
The ring waits. Seven doors — some open, some priced beyond you. The choice is which risk you take.
◈ the Feared
— 42 distinct monsters faced blow-by-blow. The footage exists, and it plays unasked.
(standing: 100)
◇ the Indispensable
— The Indispensable needs a full seat — the galaxy must actually need you, not just notice you.
◈ the Beloved
— Viewership 63, fan favor 23 — the galaxy's favorite, by the numbers.
(standing: 100)
◈ the Witness
— 7 exposures on the record. The docket is real.
(standing: 81)
◈ the Assimilated
— Always open. The table takes anyone — that's what makes it a trap, and what makes it safe.
(standing: 55)
◈ the Defiant
— Defiance 7 on the record. The 'no' is earned.
(standing: 48)
◈ the Relay
— Stage-3 neural integration. The matrix doesn't care about your kingdom — it cares how deep you are. (sysbond 0)
(standing: 40)

BEAT ONE — THE FOOTAGE. The table doesn't ask what you did. It shows it: the deer, the fire, the feast-burned blade, the ones who came for you and didn't come back. A delegate with too many angles covers its face. "Choose," the System says, "what leads."
alien-terror 2 · villager-horror 0

BEAT TWO — CALIBRATION. A delegate leans too far over the light and flinches at its own reflection in your eyes. The System watches the flinch the way it watches ratings. "MORE?" it asks. "LESS?" Or — the oldest door — "PROVE IT?"
◈ YOUR BUILD
— The table has the footage. It doesn't have you, in the room, choosing.
alien-terror 4 · villager-horror 1

BEAT THREE — SPEND IT. A small village's envoy — not yours, barely on any map — is being pressed by the table for tribute it cannot pay. The System watches you watch them. Terror is currency here. You could spend yours *for* them. Or keep it.
alien-terror 1 · villager-horror 1
